conviction_note: The printed Q2 bar ($2.68 EPS / $297.8M revenue, unchanged for 60 days) was never re-based after Q1 beat by 78% on EPS and 16.7% on revenue, and it is ~10% below the quarterly run-rate the same analysts' own FY27 annual number requires; that lands on a float that is 7.4% short with 3.3 days to cover after a 33% 20-day drawdown that no source ties to company news. Netted against a backlog headline that is very likely down for a third straight quarter, I get a modest positive, well inside the 15.7% implied.

findings.finding: The Q2 FY27 consensus of $2.68 EPS / $297.8M revenue has been unchanged for 60 days - i.e. it was never re-based after Q1 printed $3.24 vs $1.82 (+78%) and $291.0M vs $249.4M (+16.7%) - and it implies revenue up only 2.3% sequentially and EPS down 17% sequentially in Argan's seasonally strongest construction quarter, while the same analysts' FY27 annual estimate ($1.28B revenue, $12.09 EPS, 5 analysts, as of 2026-08-26) requires ~$330M and ~$2.95 per quarter across Q2-Q4.
findings.why_not_priced: The wire will print '$2.68 expected' and every screen will compare to it. What is not priced is that the quarterly and annual estimates from the same five analysts are mutually inconsistent by ~10% on revenue for this specific quarter: nobody reconciles a stale, 2-estimate quarterly stub against a 5-estimate annual number. If the market had reconciled them, the Q2 estimate would have drifted up in the 60 days since the Q1 blowout instead of sitting flat, and the FY26 sequential pattern (Q1 $193.7M to Q2 $237.7M, +22.7%) would have been reflected in a Q2 number above $320M rather than $297.8M.
findings.independence: stockanalysis.com's forecast page carries the FY27 annual consensus of $1.28B revenue and $12.09 EPS on 5 analysts, as of 2026-08-26 - a different source from the Zacks quarterly stub, and the arithmetic residual ($1.28B less Q1's actual $291.0M, over three quarters) is what makes the quarterly bar look low: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/agx/forecast/

findings.finding: Short interest is 1.02M shares - 7.38% of float and 3.28 days to cover as of the 2026-09-02 data date - on only 14.02M shares outstanding, and days-to-cover is up 65% year over year; the position was built during a 33% 20-day drawdown that the only article addressing it attributes entirely to a sector reassessment with no Argan-specific news.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is not a directional forecast, so this is a convexity claim, not a view: on a 14.0M-share company with 277k shares of daily volume, 1.02M shares short is 3.3 sessions of covering demand that has to transact in the session after the print. If the market had priced the squeeze risk, the 25-delta skew would be negative (calls bid) rather than +2.6 with downside paid, and the front-expiry open interest would not be sitting at only 8,200 contracts with a 20%-of-mid ATM spread. Instead the chain is call-heavy on open interest (0.31 put/call) but put-bid on vol - an inconsistency that says the chain is illiquid rather than informed.
findings.independence: Different source, same direction on the 'washed out without cause' leg: the 2026-08-29 Yahoo piece states the fall came 'amid a broad selloff across engineering and construction stocks' and names no Argan-specific trigger, and puts the P/E at 36.3x against an industry 32.5x - https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/argan-agx-undervalued-sector-led-061615421.html . This finding shares no document with finding 1.

findings.finding: In a Q1 10-Q footnote, contract liabilities (customer billings and advances ahead of cost) rose to $565.8M at 2026-04-30 from $514.0M at 2026-01-31 while $222.6M of revenue was recognised out of that balance - implying roughly $274M of fresh customer cash advanced in a quarter that recognised $291M of revenue, against contract assets of only $36.9M.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the single best leading indicator Argan discloses - customers do not prepay nearly two quarters of revenue on work they are about to stop - and it sits in a revenue-recognition footnote that no aggregator carries and that a five-analyst coverage list does not model. The August de-rating was a bet that the power-EPC order and spend cycle is rolling over; had anyone priced this footnote, the drawdown would not have been indiscriminate with the E&C group, and the sell-side notes cited in the wire (Zacks to Hold 08-07, Weiss cut 08-11) would have argued about funded backlog rather than about ratings.
findings.independence: Corroborated in a different document by the same filer, so treat as one cluster: the 2026-06-04 earnings release reports cash and investments of $973.6M with zero debt, which is the balance-sheet consequence of the advance build - https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/100591/000110465926070517/agx-20260604xex99d1.htm . Flagging the shared filer explicitly.

findings.finding: Backlog has now declined for two straight quarters from its peak - RUPO of $3.0B at 2026-10-31 per the Q3 10-Q, $2.9B at 2026-01-31, $2.8B at 2026-04-30 - and Argan has press-released and 8-K'd zero new power EPC awards in the three months since the Q1 call, the only 8-K being an $8.3M teledata bolt-on (ValCor, 2026-08-04), against management's Q1 guidance of 'a handful of new projects over the next 10 to 18 months' and add-on backlog additions of only ~$125M in Q1; on ~$320-350M of Q2 revenue that makes a third consecutive sequential decline to roughly $2.6-2.7B the likely headline.
findings.why_not_priced: The arithmetic is doable by anyone but the inputs are scattered across a 10-Q RUPO note, an earnings release, an absence of 8-Ks and a call transcript, and with five analysts nobody publishes it. What is genuinely mispriced is the framing: the wire narrative on AGX is 'record revenue, record backlog', and the Oct-2025 $3.0B peak is not the number quoted anywhere in current coverage. I size this smaller than the bear case looks because the baseline's own history contradicts the reflex: the +37.91% print on 2026-03-26 came with backlog DOWN sequentially from $3.0B to $2.9B, and the -11.98% print on 2025-12-04 came with a RECORD $3.0B backlog. This stock's reaction function is revenue and margin, not backlog direction.
findings.independence: The zero-award leg is independently visible in the company's own EDGAR filing record for CIK 0000100591 between 2026-06-04 and 2026-09-02 (only 8-Ks are the 06-10 dividend and the 08-04 ValCor acquisition): https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0000100591&type=8-K&dateb=&owner=include&count=40 . This finding shares its 'award pipeline' mechanism with finding 5 - collapse them if scoring a cluster.

findings.finding: Two state-level restrictions on data-center grid interconnection landed after Argan last spoke to investors on 2026-06-04 - Abbott ordered PUCT/ERCOT to audit data centers before approving new connections and ERCOT paused its 'batch zero' review (2026-08-03), and Pennsylvania restricted data-center permitting (2026-08-18, on which Talen fell 11%) - but the Texas order explicitly exempts data centers with on-site power generation, which is precisely the dedicated behind-the-meter gas plant Gemma builds.
findings.why_not_priced: The market traded AGX as an undifferentiated data-center-capex derivative through August. The specific carve-out - grid connection frozen, on-site generation exempt - channels hyperscaler demand toward exactly Argan's product in exactly Argan's biggest market (both mega-projects in backlog are ERCOT). If this had been priced, AGX would have decoupled from the IPP and grid-connected names in the 08-18 to 08-29 leg instead of falling with them. I keep the sign slightly negative only because management now has to answer pipeline questions for the first time with this as the backdrop, and the timeline has already compressed once.
findings.independence: Different source, same policy wave: S&P Global Market Intelligence on the Pennsylvania permitting restriction and the IPP reaction, dated August 2026 (/articles/2026/8/) - https://www.spglobal.com/market-intelligence/en/news-insights/articles/2026/8/ipp-stocks-slip-after-pa-governor-restricts-data-center-permitting-105193411 . Shares the award-pipeline mechanism with finding 4.

findings.finding: Director John R. Jeffrey Jr. sold 5,716 shares at an average $579.64 on 2026-07-31, cutting his direct holding to 2,533 shares - roughly a 69% reduction of direct ownership, executed within 4% of the 52-week high and 41% above the current $412 spot.
findings.why_not_priced: Small and one director, so I size it near zero; it is here because it dates the top precisely and because the June 12-23 Form 4/144 cluster around the 06-10 annual meeting was routine grant-and-sell while this one was not. Note the offsetting fact from the same filer family: the board raised the repurchase authorisation by $50M to $200M on 2026-04-08 and the company itself bought stock in Q1 at an average $458.21 - above today's price - with $421.4M of net liquidity, so a disclosed August repurchase is a live upside surprise on this call.

searched_and_found_nothing: EIA-860M planned-generator records for Sandow Lakes Energy Station (1,290 MW, Lee County TX) show an expected COD of 2028-12-01 with no evidence of a schedule slip - no revenue-deferral signal on Argan's largest project
Gemma Power Systems' own newsroom has no 2026 posts at all (last item April 2025), so it gave no independent read on project milestones

ZipRecruiter/Indeed job postings for Gemma Power name only a site 'just outside Austin, TX' (i.e. Sandow Lakes) - no posting pointing to an unannounced new project site, which would have been the cleanest positive tell

Searched for Gemma Power litigation, liens, site incidents or labour disputes in 2026 and found none; the only live dispute is the legacy Kilroot/EP NI Energy claim (APC terminated May 2024, $9.9M letter of credit drawn, $25.1M billable at risk) which has been disclosed for two years and shows no 2026 court development
Movethegasplant.org (the Lee County opposition group) confirms TCEQ let construction start and shows no 2026 injunction or construction halt on Sandow Lakes; its blog index would not load
Could not identify the customer for the 860 MW ERCOT project contracted 2025-11-06, so no counterparty-side disclosure check was possible on that piece of backlog
No 8-K, press release or Form 8-K item 8.01 disclosing a new power EPC award between 2026-06-04 and 2026-09-02 - an absence rather than a find, and it is finding 4
No company-specific news source could be found for the 2026-08-21 (-6.7%) and 2026-08-25 (-4.3%) single-day declines; both appear to be sector sympathy
baseline_tension: My net lean cuts against the +2.63 downside-paid skew and against the 33% 20-day run-down - I think the estimate stub and the short position are the unpriced parts and the backlog decline is the part the drawdown already paid for - but it agrees with the baseline's own reaction history, where the +37.9% print came on a falling backlog and the -12.0% print came on a record one.
